text: qa_verify/verify must name test files with a glob (node --test 'dir/*.test.mjs'), never a bare directory: on Node 22 'node --test dir/' tries to run the directory as a file and fails
evidence: Lead's cards used 'node --test test/indicators/integration/<name>/'; it failed on Node 22.22 locally, so Michael rewrote qa_verify to the glob form before validate
